title: Holdout at Harmon's
summary: Five strangers barricaded inside a rural hardware store, 23 days into the outbreak. The dead are slow but endless; the living are the real danger.
toneNote: Bleak and personal: the dead are constant pressure, the living are the drama.
setting: Day 23 of the outbreak. Five strangers have barricaded themselves inside Harmon's Hardware, a rural store off a two-lane highway. The town is quiet in the worst way. Radio and phones are mostly dead, gas is scarce, and the dead are slow but endless. Nobody here chose each other.
rules: The dead are slow, relentless and drawn by noise and light. A bite is fatal within a day or two; there is no cure.
Realistic tone: injuries matter, supplies run out, guns are loud and ammunition is scarce.
The living are the real danger: fear, grudges and secrets drive conflict inside the group.

world.food: about four days for five people
world.vehicles: a pickup in the lot, no keys found

factions.name: Coastal rescue convoy
factions.desc: An armed convoy evacuating survivors to a coastal safe zone, broadcasting on handheld radio bands.
factions.stance: heading for the highway junction; says it can take only three more people

factions.name: The Ridge
factions.desc: Armed survivors holed up in the next town over. Nobody here knows much about them.
factions.stance: unknown; their trucks were seen scavenging along the highway

regions.name: The highway strip
regions.lore: The edge of town along the two-lane highway: Harmon's Hardware, a gas station with dry pumps, a diner and a feed store.

regions.name: Main Street
regions.status: the dead fill the streets around the courthouse
regions.lore: The old town centre: courthouse, pharmacy, church and the clinic where the first evacuation was organised and went wrong.

regions.name: The houses
regions.status: mostly looted, some doors still locked
regions.lore: Streets of small houses and trailers behind Main Street. Some families left in a hurry; some never left.

regions.name: Highway junction
regions.lore: Where the two-lane highway meets the interstate, a few miles out. Anyone heading for the coast passes through here.

regions.name: Ridge
regions.lore: The next town over, up the ridge road. Its survivors walled off the school and the grain elevator early.

regional.text: a fire spreading through the town
another group of survivors passing on the highway

the military bombing a nearby city

extras.name: Mrs. Albee
extras.note: Has been living in the trailer at the loading dock since day three; deaf in one ear, sharp otherwise, keeps a shotgun she says is not loaded.

standees.label: stragglers
standees.note: Slow dead that wandered off the highway ahead of the herd; they bunch up at the dock door when they hear noise.

majorSeeds: the dead break through a window
someone in the group gets bitten
part of the food stash is found missing
a gunshot nearby draws the dead
